items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Well, I didn't have much contact with him, see. Since on the bandstand he was always the leader

ctx.x: I don't remember. I think Rex just had it... You know, bands are a lot of problems, and transportation, you know... And we had started to see it good, but...
He was an excellent fellow. I never knew that
